title: ai-rulez Provider Spec
description: Declarative provider definition consumed by the generic DSL renderer. Each builtin provider (claude, copilot, codex, ...) and any user-defined provider is expressed as one of these documents. The renderer dispatches purely on the closed-set enums declared here; new behaviors require extending the enums + adding a Go handler.

name.description: Identifier used to register the provider (e.g. "claude"). Matches the preset name in .ai-rulez/config.toml `presets`.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in logs and docs.

directories.description: Directory paths (relative to baseDir) the renderer must emit as IsDir outputs so they participate in stale-file cleanup.

outputs.description: Per-content-type emit rules. Keys are the content types defined in the content tree.

sidecars.description: Conditionally-emitted single files (settings.json, .mcp.json, etc.) dispatched on the closed-set `kind` enum.

file.description: Relative path of the root file.

local_file.description: Machine-local counterpart of the root file that the tool loads natively. Omit for the ".local" variant of file (CLAUDE.md -> CLAUDE.local.md), "none" when the tool has no such file, or a slash-separated relative path inside the project (no backslash, drive letter or "..", and not file itself).

omit_header_agents.description: When true, the detailed header of the root file reports no agents (agents=0), matching a root file that another preset also writes with that count.

sections.description: Ordered list of section renderers to compose into the root file body.

mode.description: `per_item_file` writes one file per item. `aggregate` (outputs.checks only) renders every item into the single file named by `file`, as `<!-- ai-rulez:check:NAME -->` sections. Inlined-only content types are expressed via the root.sections list instead.

dir.description: Directory (relative to baseDir) where per-item files are emitted.

resources.description: When true, also emit bundled skill resources (references/, scripts/, assets/) under the item directory.

filter.description: Closed-set filter predicate. include_if_targeting_provider keeps a command/agent whose Metadata.Targets is empty or contains the provider name. path_scoped keeps only items that declare a path scope (globs/paths frontmatter). placement_core keeps skills and commands generated into the provider directory: it drops items that [placement] or the `placement` frontmatter ships only through a plugin, and applies `targets` to commands (and to skills with placement.honor_targets). Not allowed together with `split`.

split.description: outputs.rules only. When true the output honors the `[rules] mode` setting: split mode writes every rule and path-scoped context item to a file, inline mode writes only the items selected by `inline_filter`. Requires `dialect` and a flat `{id}<ext>` filename.

inline_filter.description: outputs.rules with `split` only. Items that still get a rule file when the rules mode is inline. Omit to keep everything inline.

inline_unscoped.description: outputs.rules with `split` only. Items the tool's rule files cannot apply automatically (auto and manual activation, globs that are all negated) stay in the root file instead of becoming rule files (copilot has no applyTo for them).

always_files.description: outputs.rules with `split` only. Every rule and context item becomes a rule file in every rules mode, always-on ones included, and root.sections need not include `rules_inline`. For tools whose rules live only in a folder (no root file).

dialect.description: outputs.rules with `split` only. Frontmatter vocabulary of the rule files. `mapped` is implied by an `activation` block and builds the frontmatter from it. Cannot be combined with `body` or `frontmatter`.

file.description: outputs with mode `aggregate` only. Relative, slash-separated path of the single file every item is rendered into.

header.description: outputs with mode `aggregate` only. Text written above the first item.

fields.description: Whitelisted Metadata.Extra keys to copy into the frontmatter, in this order. Empty/missing keys are skipped.

constants.description: Fixed key/value pairs unconditionally written to the frontmatter (e.g. {"user-invocable": false}).

tools.description: When true, emit Metadata.Tools as a YAML list under the `tools` key.

skills.description: When true, emit Metadata.Skills as a YAML list under the `skills` key.

paths.description: When true, copy a rule's path scope (its globs/paths frontmatter) into a `paths` field, which is how Claude Code scopes a rule file.

include_extras.description: When true, copy every remaining Metadata.Extra key into the frontmatter except those in `extras_blacklist`.

extras_blacklist.description: Keys to exclude when `include_extras` is true. Used to drop ai-rulez internals (priority, targets) and keys handled elsewhere.

emit_effort.description: When true, call the shared effort resolver and emit under the `effort` key using the provider's effort_map.

emit_model.description: When true, call the shared per-preset model resolver and emit under model.field.

effort_field.description: Frontmatter key the resolved effort is written under when emit_effort is true. Defaults to "effort"; tools whose thinking knob is spelled differently set it (pi: "thinking").

omit_name.description: When true, leave the always-present `name` key out of the frontmatter (tools that take the name from the filename).

name_first.description: When true, write `name` first and the remaining frontmatter keys alphabetically, instead of every key alphabetically.

quoted_fields.description: Frontmatter keys whose string value is always written double-quoted.

join_lists.description: When true, write the tools and skills lists as one comma-separated string ("read, grep") instead of a YAML list, for tools whose frontmatter parser reads only scalars (Letta Code).

style.description: Currently only `string`-valued effort maps are supported.

field.description: Frontmatter key the resolved model string is written under (e.g. `model`).

kind.description: Closed-set sidecar renderer. The tool-specific kinds render a fixed document; the generic kinds (`mcp`, and the reserved `permissions` and `hooks`) merge into any json, jsonc, toml or yaml document. `permissions` and `hooks` validate but are not rendered yet. New kinds extend this enum and add a Go handler in providers/sidecars.go.

path.description: Relative output path. Object-shaped sidecars are merged into an existing file at this path: only the keys the renderer owns are replaced, every other key is preserved.

emit_when.description: Closed-set predicate evaluated against the Config to decide whether to emit. Defaults to `has_mcp_servers` for kind `mcp`, otherwise `always`.

format.description: Generic kinds only. Document format; defaults to the one the path's extension names.

key.description: Generic kinds only. Path of the owned member; each element is a literal member name, so ["amp.mcpServers"] is one flat key and ["amp","mcpServers"] a nested object. Defaults to the dialect's key.

dialect.description: Kind `mcp` only. Entry style: standard (mcpServers command/args/env, url/headers), claude (type http|sse), gemini (httpUrl), opencode (mcp.<name> type local|remote, command array, environment, enabled), vscode (servers, type stdio|http|sse), zed (context_servers), codex ([mcp_servers.<name>] with http_headers), amp (flat key amp.mcpServers), yaml-standard (Poolside mcp_servers with a transport block), transport (mcpServers keyed on `transport`, Kimi Code), vibe ([[mcp_servers]] array of tables with name, Mistral Vibe). Defaults to standard. Each dialect has a default `key`.

global_path.description: User-scope path of the sidecar, relative to the home directory.

elements.description: Kind `mcp` on a json or jsonc document only. Also adds values to an array member of the document (Kilo's `instructions` globs); every other element of the array stays the consumer's. Without `emit_when` the sidecar is then written even with no MCP servers.

global_mcp_path.description: User-scope path of the sidecar's MCP servers when it differs from global_path, relative to the home directory (Claude Code keeps them in .claude.json). Only valid on a sidecar that holds MCP servers.

activation.description: outputs.rules with `split` only. Maps each activation mode of a rule onto the frontmatter fields of the tool's rules folder. String values may use the placeholders {globs} (globs joined with ","), {globs_list} (the globs as a list when it is the whole value), {description} and {name}; a key that resolves to nothing is dropped. A mode without a table is loaded always (reported as a downgrade); an absent `always` table writes no frontmatter.

glob.description: Frontmatter of a rule scoped to file globs.

auto.description: Frontmatter of a rule the model applies from its description.

manual.description: Frontmatter of a rule applied only when invoked.

format.description: `yaml` (default) or `lines`: bare `key: value` lines between --- fences with lists joined by ", ".

global.description: User-scope (home directory) layout of the tool. Every path is relative to the user's home and slash-separated. Declarative only: parsed and validated, exposed through ProviderSpec.GlobalPaths.

home_env.description: Environment variable that relocates the tool's home (e.g. HERMES_HOME). When set, the part of each path under `home_dir` is re-rooted at its value. Requires `home_dir`.

home_dir.description: The tool's directory under the user's home (e.g. ".hermes"). Requires `home_env`; every other path must lie inside it.
